title: pentaphylloides glabra
intro: Pentaphylloides glabra, commonly known as Chinese angelica tree or Chinese angelica, is a perennial plant species native to Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pentaphylloides glabra include anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as arthritis, bronchitis, and pneumonia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
